feature: Personal lists, reminders and Google A2UI chat surfaces
scope: Source implementation and controlled host, gateway and browser verification
environment: Isolated Node 24 Linux host with synthetic accounts, local SQLite, controlled clock and fixture PWCE transport. Browser checks used Windows Chrome and Linux headless Chromium.

checks.environment: Windows with PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE set to a local Playwright installation

checks.check: Ajv validated list with pagination, trigger form, private reminder card and generic reminder card against the Google A2UI v0.8 standard catalog server-to-client schema

failures: Telegram candidate startup polling deadline exceeded
checks.skip: Generated browser pixels traverse authenticated frame transport and are disposed after interpretation

checks.detail: Game reflection passed. The Telegram candidate startup polling deadline recurred.
The original Telegram launcher test passed with a warm Node compile cache.

browserScenarios: Windows Chrome added wood glue to a shopping list in chat, displayed the saved list, activated Done and opened a new authenticated session that showed the completed item.

Windows Chrome set a 4 PM reminder in America/Chicago and closed the authoring session. The synthetic phone remained offline. Fresh person-specific shop presence routed the due reminder to one visible wall card. Repolling did not duplicate it. The render receipt recorded delivery. Done recorded acknowledgment. A fresh Windows session showed the completed item and no remaining work.

qualificationOutstanding: Actual person and zone bindings through the deployed PWCE gateway
